questions.question: An increase in money supply will cause interest rates to _______.
questions.solution:

• So, to attract debtors, the money lenders reduce the interest rates.

questions.question: Which Schedule of Indian Constitution has provisions relating to disqualification of Member of Parliament on the ground of defection?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tenth Schedule.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 52nd Amendment of the Indian Constitution relates to Anti-defection Law.
 
• The 52nd Amendment Act of 1985 provided for the disqualification of the members of Parliament and the state legislature on the ground of the Deflection of one political party to another.
 
• The 10th Schedule of the Indian Constitution is designed to prevent political defections prompted by the lure of office, material benefits, or other considerations.
 
• The Anti-defection law was passed by Parliament in 1985 and was reinforced in 2002.
 
• The 10th Schedule of the Indian Constitution popularly referred to as the ‘Anti-Defection Law’ was inserted by the 52nd Amendment (1985) to the Constitution.
 
• ‘Defection’ has been defined as per the constitution as, “To abandon a position or association, often to join an opposing group”.
 
• The anti-defection law was enacted to ensure that a party member does not violate the mandate of the party or else on doing so he will lose his membership in the House.
 
• The law applies to both Parliament and state assemblies.
 
• The aim of the Anti-Defection Law is to prevent MPs from switching political parties for any personal motive.

questions.question: Due to an acceleration of 1 m/s2 the velocity of a body increases from 5 m/s to 10 m/s in a certain period. Find the displacement (in m) of the body in that period.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**37.5.**__

__**Calculation:**__

Here,

Initial velocity; u = 5 m/s

Final velocity; v= 10 m/s

Acceleration given; a = 1 m/s²

Let the displacement be ‘S’

Using the formula;

**[ v² – u² = 2*a*S ]**

and putting the values we get, Displacement (S) = 37.5 m

questions.question: As an object falls freely its________ .

options.text: Kinetic energy gets converted into potential energy
Potential energy gets converted into kinetic energy
Momentum gets converted into gravitational force
Gravitational force gets converted into momentum

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Potential energy gets converted into kinetic energy.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• When an object (mass m) is at any height (h) from the ground, it attains potential energy (PE) due to the virtue of its position wrt to the ground ie.** PE = mgh**
 
• As it falls, the value of h decreases and as a consequence its PE decreases and gets converted into kinetic energy.
 
• Kinetic energy is the energy which is acquired from the motion of the object and the object is obviously in motion when it falls.
